motions.topic: Build a native platform benchmark suite that measures the in-kernel machinery, not ingested models. Scope: (1) TRM-7M thinking — think() latency ns/turn and the council k3 vote latency; (2) fabric/recall — P@1 over the labeled 5-domain set (expand to ~200+ queries; 8 queries gives SE ~35%), plus ms/query and score spread over the 199k-document packed store; (3) council — full propose->deliberate->vote->enact latency and consensus rate; (4) deterministic tiers — arithmetic + introspection latency; (5) GPU fast path — gpu_scan_scores_cached vs CPU k3 scan (the cached OnceLock buffers are ~35x; measure the real delta). Honesty contract: every number labeled measured_on_host/derived/declared_constant; black_box all inputs; noise = the measurement's own precision (binomial SE + Wilson 95% CI); before/after on the SAME set; pre-register any transform prediction before the run. Receipt: a sealed benchmark artifact (swarm_v2_artifacts/platform_benchmarks.json) with per-metric values + labels, served live by a /benchmarks endpoint. MEASURED (this host, live): /health returns kernel/memory_kb/monad_anchor/status/uptime_seconds; /recall routes over 199,218 documents (native-turbovec-hdc encoder, score spread sd 0.0347); the council reports k3_model_latency_ns 7,432,200 (TRM-7M vote) with a k3_trit verdict; deterministic arithmetic answers at ~0.00s. Prior honest baselines on file: k3 retrieval ~0.9-1.5 ms/query over the 76.7MB fabric, TRM Brain ~3.9 us/inference, SRAM ~1.5M ops/s. The honesty contract is already the project standard: black_box all loop inputs (compiler elision has fabricated 1e12 ops/s before), label every number measured_on_host/derived/declared_constant, and treat noise as the measurement's own precision (binomial SE + Wilson 95% CI), never a synthetic noise term. REJECT AS PREMATURE if any metric cannot be produced with a labeled kind (a number without a measured/derived/declared_constant label is not a benchmark, it is an assertion) — in which case the council names the missing measurement and schedules it rather than shipping an unlabeled figure.
